list.heading: My trips
list.sub: Manage your journeys and trip details
list.emptyCurrentTitle: You have no trips in progress
list.emptyCurrentBody: Find a car you like and book your first trip.
list.emptyHistoryBody: Completed and cancelled trips are kept here.
list.stageEmptyAction: Tap to clear the filter and see all trips.
list.stageEmptyBody: The filter applies to the page you are viewing. Clear it or try another page.
list.searchLabel: Search by vehicle name or booking code
list.narrowEmptyBody: Try another keyword or change the date range.
list.emptyTransitionalBody: Every trip you rented has been closed. Trips where customers book your shop are under Bookings.

auth.expiredList: Please sign in again to keep viewing your trips.
auth.expiredDetail: Please sign in again to view this trip.

detail.heading: Trip details
detail.notFoundTitle: This trip doesn't exist or has been deleted
detail.notFoundBody: That trip id could not be found.
detail.activeNote: If anything changes, contact the host as early as you can.
detail.priceEmpty: The final price appears as soon as the host accepts your request.

directDeposit.title: Deposit arranged directly with the shop
directDeposit.body: The shop will contact you to arrange the deposit directly. XePrime neither collects nor reconciles it, so if a dispute over the deposit arises XePrime has no record to support you.

evidence.title: Handover records
evidence.lead: Condition photos and odometer readings the shop recorded at pickup and at return.
evidence.empty: The shop has not confirmed any handover record for this trip yet.
evidence.noPhotos: The shop did not keep condition photos for this handover.
evidence.addedLate: Added after the handover was confirmed
evidence.addedLateHint: This photo was uploaded after the shop confirmed the handover, so it was not taken at the moment of handover.
evidence.disclaimer: This record was made by the shop. If anything looks different, please contact the shop directly.

subtitle.pending_approval: Your rental request has been sent to the host
subtitle.awaiting_hold: The host accepted your trip — pay the reservation amount to lock it in
subtitle.ready: The host has confirmed your rental request
subtitle.active: You have this car right now — drive safely
subtitle.completed: The trip is complete. Thanks for riding with XePrime!
subtitle.pending_approval_paid: Your reservation payment has been received. Waiting for the host to confirm — if they decline, the full amount is refunded right away.
subtitle.slot_taken: Another customer booked these dates first
subtitle.expired: The host didn't reply in time, so this request closed. You can pick another car.

notice.pendingTitle: Waiting for the host to confirm
notice.pendingBody: The host is reviewing your request. You'll get a notification as soon as they reply.
notice.rejectedBody: The host can't take this request. You can look for another car for the same dates.
notice.expiredTitle: The host didn't respond in time
notice.expiredBody: The request closed automatically because the host didn't reply within the deadline. You can choose another car for the same dates.
notice.cancelledBody: This trip was cancelled. Any hold on the schedule has been released.
notice.noShowBody: This trip was marked as no-show at pick-up time. Contact the host if you think that's a mistake.
notice.slotTakenBody: The dates you picked were just booked by someone else. You can choose another car or different dates.

timeline.ariaPending: Trip progress: confirmed, not yet completed

actions.title: Need help with this trip?
actions.contactLocked: Contact opens once the host approves your request. Anything arranged before that is outside XePrime support.

notReceived.title: Haven't received the vehicle?
notReceived.lead: If the pickup time has passed and you have not received the vehicle, or the host did not show up, let XePrime know before {time}.
notReceived.dialogBody: XePrime will hold all money for this trip (nothing is paid out to the host) and contact both you and the host to verify.
notReceived.dialogNote: Only report this if you really have not received the vehicle. If you have it, ignore this.
notReceived.success: Report sent. XePrime will contact you shortly.
notReceived.openTitle: Your vehicle-not-received report is being handled
notReceived.openBody: XePrime is holding the money for this trip and will contact you and the host to verify.
notReceived.hostOpenTitle: This trip has an open complaint
notReceived.hostOpenBody: XePrime is holding the money for this trip and will contact both sides to verify. If you have handed the vehicle over, confirm the handover record (with photos if you have them) so XePrime has evidence to verify.

cancel.title: Cancel trip
cancel.leadPending: Your rental request will be withdrawn and the host will be notified. You can send a new request for this car at any time. This cannot be undone!
cancel.leadReady: The booking will be cancelled and the car opens up for other renters. This cannot be undone.
cancel.leadAwaitingHold: The owner is holding the car for you. If you cancel, the car opens up for other renters. This cannot be undone.
cancel.paidTitle: You have already paid for this trip
cancel.refundNote: XePrime only records status — it does not move money. Please contact the host to arrange the refund.

preview.error: We couldn't preview your refund. You can still cancel — the refund follows the cancellation & refund policy at the moment you confirm.
preview.fullRefundTitle: {amount} will be refunded to your Points wallet
preview.fullRefundBefore: You transferred {paid} as a reservation payment and are cancelling before {time}, so it is refunded in full as soon as you cancel.
preview.fullRefundBody: You transferred {paid} as a reservation payment. It is refunded in full to your Points wallet as soon as you cancel.
preview.noFreeCancelTitle: This trip has no free-cancellation window
preview.lateBody: The {insurance} insurance is refunded in full because no policy has been issued yet. The rest of the reservation payment (the booking fee and the rent paid in advance) is not refunded: the owner is compensated for holding the car for you, and the remainder goes to XePrime.
preview.lateBodyNoInsurance: The reservation payment (the booking fee and the rent paid in advance) is not refunded: the owner is compensated for holding the car for you, and the remainder goes to XePrime.
preview.deferred: This trip has an open dispute — XePrime will settle this amount once it is resolved.
preview.notAllowedTitle: This trip can no longer be cancelled
preview.notAllowedBody: The trip has already started or ended. To return the vehicle early, contact the owner to hand it back and settle up.

cancel.leadPaid: You have paid the reservation fee for this trip. Your refund follows the <policy>Cancellation policy</policy>. This cannot be undone!

finance.legacy: This is an older trip, so only the total was kept — the line items are no longer available.
finance.additionalDueBody: The extra charges exceed the deposit held. Please settle the difference directly with the host.
finance.depositNotReceived: The host has not recorded receiving the {amount} deposit for this trip. If you already transferred it, please contact the host to reconcile.
finance.deductNote: The deducted part is already inside the total above — it is how you paid those extra charges, not a second deduction.
finance.refundedTail: . Please check against your own account.
finance.awaitingRefund: The host will transfer this back and mark the deposit as refunded here. XePrime records the status; it does not move money.
finance.holding: The host holds this deposit for the whole trip. The refund amount is settled after you return the car.
finance.settled: The deposit was fully used for the extra charges above, so there is nothing left to refund.

invoice.refundNeedsAccount: Tell us which account to send this refund to.

review.title: Rate this trip
review.alreadyReviewed: You have already reviewed this trip.

validation.commentTooLong: Comment can be at most {max} characters

review.editHint: You can edit your review only once.

hold.title: Reservation payment
hold.intro: Transfer exactly the amount and note below to confirm the trip.
hold.partialIntro: We received {paid}. Send the remainder using the SAME transfer reference to confirm.
hold.expires: If the full amount does not arrive in time, the vehicle reopens for other customers.
hold.freeCancel: Cancel before {time} for a full refund of what you paid online.
hold.restAtHandover: The remaining rental is paid directly to the host at pickup.
hold.paid: Reservation payment of {amount} received. Your trip is confirmed.
hold.expired: The payment window closed, so the vehicle reopened for other customers. You can book another trip.
hold.refundPaid: XePrime refunded {amount} to the account you provided.
hold.refundPending: Waiting for XePrime to transfer {amount} back to you.
hold.refundNeedsAccount: {amount} is waiting to be refunded — tell us where to send it.
hold.freeCancelSoon: This trip starts soon, so free cancellation ends BEFORE the payment deadline: only cancelling before {time} gets you a full refund of what you paid.
hold.vsDepositHint: The reservation payment goes to XePrime to confirm the trip and counts towards your rental. It is not the security deposit — that is left with the host at pickup and returned when you bring the car back undamaged.
hold.vsDepositHintLabel: How the reservation payment differs from the security deposit
hold.codeHint: The transfer reference is what matches your money to this trip. Scanning the QR fills it in; if you type the transfer yourself, keep every character.
hold.codeHintLabel: Why the transfer reference must stay exact
hold.checkingBody: Banks usually report to XePrime within a few minutes. This page updates itself when the money lands — no need to send it again.
hold.qrFailed: The QR code didn't load. Use the details beside it to transfer manually.
hold.qrUnavailable: No QR code is available for this payment. Use the amount and reference beside it to transfer.
hold.lateCancelRefund: After that: the {amount} insurance is refunded in full to your Points wallet; the booking fee and the rent paid in advance are not refunded (the owner is compensated for holding the car for you, and the remainder goes to XePrime).
hold.lateCancelNoRefund: After that, the reservation payment is not refunded (the owner is compensated for holding the car for you, and the remainder goes to XePrime).
hold.noFreeCancelRefund: This trip has no free-cancellation window. If you cancel after paying, the {amount} insurance is refunded in full to your Points wallet; the booking fee and the rent paid in advance are not refunded (the owner is compensated for holding the car for you, and the remainder goes to XePrime).
hold.noFreeCancelNoRefund: This trip has no free-cancellation window. If you cancel after paying, the reservation payment is not refunded (the owner is compensated for holding the car for you, and the remainder goes to XePrime).

owner.heading: Trips I host
owner.sub: Rental requests waiting for you, and bookings on your vehicles.

requests.title: Requests awaiting approval
requests.sub: Guests are waiting for your answer. Approving holds the vehicle for that period.
requests.emptyBody: New rental requests show up here with their response deadline.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.emptyBody: A booking is created as soon as you approve a rental request.
bookings.noResultsBody: Try another status or clear the filter.

host.decisionHint: The guest is waiting for you. Approving holds the vehicle for that period.
host.acceptedHint: Waiting for the guest to send the reservation payment. The dates are held; if the payment does not arrive in time, they are released automatically.

hostList.heading: Rental trips
hostList.sub: Requests and bookings for your vehicles — approve, follow up and hand over in one place.
hostList.emptyCurrentBody: When a guest requests one of your vehicles, the trip shows up here for you to review.

estimate.title: Price details
estimate.noteRenter: Priced with the policy in force. The final amount is confirmed when the host approves.
estimate.noteHost: Trip fees sit on the guest side and are not deducted from your payout. The final amount is confirmed when you approve.
estimate.noteSettled: These figures were locked when you paid the reservation and will not change.

payment.title: Pay the booking hold
payment.subtitle: Rental of {vehicle}
payment.notFoundBody: This trip does not exist or does not belong to your account.
payment.loadErrorTitle: Could not load the payment details
payment.noHoldTitle: Nothing to pay for this trip yet
payment.noHoldBody: A booking hold is only created once the owner accepts the trip. You will be notified as soon as it is time to pay.
payment.paidBody: We received {amount} for booking hold {code}. Your trip is confirmed.

methods.transferHint: Scan with any banking app - do NOT change the amount or the transfer note!

summary.payOwnerNote: What you pay the owner after every amount due online is deducted.

notes.auto: The system confirms automatically once the payment is received.
notes.expires: If payment is not completed within this time, the reservation is cancelled automatically.
notes.safety: Only transfer to the account details shown here so your payment is processed correctly.

success.title: Payment successful
success.payOwnerNote: What you pay the owner after every amount due online is deducted.

unpaid.reminderTitle: {count, plural, one {You have # trip awaiting payment} other {You have # trips awaiting payment}}
unpaid.reminderBody: Pay before the timer runs out to keep the car — unpaid trips are cancelled automatically when the hold expires.
unpaid.limitTitle: You are holding the maximum of {limit} unpaid trips
unpaid.limitBody: You can't book another car yet. Each account can hold up to {limit} unpaid trips at a time — pay for or cancel one to keep booking.
unpaid.limitBodyBooking: Each account can hold up to {limit} unpaid trips at a time. Pay for or cancel one below, then come back to book this car.
unpaid.limitTitleFallback: You have too many trips awaiting payment
unpaid.limitBodyFallback: Pay for or cancel a trip in My trips, then come back to book this car.

status.title: Your request has been received
status.body: The owner has until {time} to respond. XePrime will notify you as soon as they accept or decline the trip.
status.bodyNoDeadline: The owner is reviewing your request. XePrime will notify you as soon as they accept or decline the trip.
status.guidanceHold: The car is not held for you yet. Your trip is only confirmed once the owner accepts it and XePrime receives the full reservation payment.
status.guidance: The car is not held for you yet. Your trip is only confirmed once the owner accepts the request.

track.title: Track your request
track.bodyHold: Nothing to pay yet. Once the owner accepts the trip, you will have up to {minutes} minutes to pay the reservation amount (less if pick-up is soon).
track.body: Nothing to pay yet. XePrime will notify you as soon as the owner responds.

pending.policyBody: You can cancel the request while the owner has not responded — nothing has been charged. Read the cancellation & refund policy for the conditions at later steps.

page.title: Rental request sent
page.description: Follow the owner's response here — nothing needs to be paid yet.

status.title: Ready for the reservation step
status.body: {owner} accepted your rental request and is holding the car for you until {time}. Your trip is confirmed as soon as XePrime receives the full reservation payment.
status.bodyClosed: {owner} accepted your rental request. See the status of the reservation payment in the next column.

pay.title: Reservation payment due
pay.body: This is only the reservation amount and it counts towards your trip total. The remaining {amount} is paid directly to the owner at pickup; any security deposit is handed over separately at pickup.
pay.bodyNoRest: This is only the reservation amount and it counts towards your trip total. Any security deposit is handed over separately at pickup.
pay.acknowledge: I have read the <policy>reservation, cancellation & refund policy</policy> that applies to this request.

policy.bodyClosed: If you cancel now, the car reopens for other renters. Read the cancellation & refund policy to see what is refunded.
policy.afterPaid: If you cancel before paying in full, the car reopens for other renters and anything you have already transferred is refunded in full to your Points wallet. After you pay: {note}

page.title: Pay the reservation
page.description: Pay the reservation amount before it expires so the owner holds the vehicle and your trip is confirmed.

sent.title: Request sent
sent.body: Your trip details have been sent to XePrime and the owner.

response.title: Awaiting owner response
response.body: The owner checks the renter details and the car condition before accepting the trip.

hold.title: Complete the reservation as instructed
hold.body: Only pay once the owner has accepted the trip and XePrime has sent you instructions.
hold.bodyCurrent: The owner has accepted the trip. Pay the reservation amount before the deadline to keep the car.

confirmed.title: Trip confirmed
confirmed.body: You will be notified once all required steps are complete.

closed.subtitle: This trip has ended

status.completedBody: Thank you for travelling with XePrime. Please take a moment to rate your trip.
status.completedBodyNoReview: Thank you for travelling with XePrime.
status.cancelledBody: Anything you paid (if any) is refunded under the cancellation policy. The details are in the trip's service invoice.
status.rejectedBody: The owner can't take this request. You can look for another vehicle for the same schedule.
status.noShowTitle: Trip recorded as not picked up
status.noShowBody: This trip was marked as not picked up on time. Contact the owner or XePrime if you think this is a mistake.
status.expiredTitle: The owner didn't respond in time
status.expiredBody: The request closed because the owner didn't reply before the deadline. You can choose another vehicle for the same schedule.
status.slotTakenBody: Another customer has just booked the time you chose. You can pick another vehicle or change your times.

support.title: Need help?
support.body: Still have questions about this trip? Choose one of the contact options below.

closed.cancelledByCustomer: You cancelled this trip. Please review the payment details below
closed.cancelledByOther: This trip was cancelled. Please review the payment details below

page.title: Your trip is confirmed
page.description: Your trip is all set. Get ready for pickup day.

status.title: See you on pickup day
status.body: Your request to rent {vehicle} from {owner} has been confirmed!

checklist.title: Pickup checklist
checklist.lead: Go through each item with the owner at handover. The items below are not marked as done yet.

licence.title: Bring a valid driving licence
licence.body: A licence that is still valid and covers this vehicle; show it for verification.

identity.title: Prepare your ID documents
identity.body: Bring documents for verification as guided and under the current policy.

inspect.title: Inspect the vehicle with the owner
inspect.body: Record the condition, {energy, select, electric {battery level} other {fuel level}} and equipment before taking the handover.

sign.title: Sign the pickup record
sign.body: Check the details and agree on the vehicle's condition in the record.

deposit.title: Pay the {amount} vehicle deposit
deposit.body: Kept separate from the rental; refunded under the policy and the pickup agreement.

asset.title: Leave a collateral item
asset.body: One of the following: {assets}. You get it back when you return the vehicle.

policy.bodyFree: Cancel before {time} and you still get 100% of the reservation amount back. After that, refunds follow the trip's cancellation & refund policy.
policy.bodyAfter: The free cancellation deadline ({time}) has passed. Cancelling now is refunded under the trip's cancellation & refund policy.
policy.bodyNoHold: You can cancel before pickup time. See the cancellation & refund policy for the conditions.
